title: Tech-Enabled Financial Data Access, Retail Investors, and Gambling-Like Behavior in the Stock Market
eligible_reason: Single event date: the Yahoo! Finance API shutdown on May 16, 2017 (post = date >= 16may2017). Treatment groups are time-invariant stock characteristics (low institutional holdings, lottery-like, small-cap). Firm-day DiD with time-varying return and news controls; a randomized experiment complements it. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: quasi-natural_experiment_analyses.do: reghdfe size_lr_retail2adj_w i.post##i.lowpih ret2_w ret2sqr_w lnrpnews [$controls], absorb(date permno) vce(cluster permno) over +/-1, 2, 3 month windows (Table 4); lottery50 and small_mcap splits (Table 2/4); institutional-trade placebo (Table 5), 2016 falsification (Table 6), liquidity (Table 8); weekly DiD (Figure 2). randomized_experiment_analyses.do: individual-level RCT.
data_access: licensed (TAQ, CRSP/Compustat, Thomson Reuters 13F, IBES, RavenPack via WRDS); experiment data public
data_files_note: ReadMe.pdf calls the two firm-day files 'synthetic datasets consisting of a random subset of the original' samples, shipped to show structure.
data_provenance_note: Firm-day files are labelled synthetic but described as random subsets of the original data; experimental data are original.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
